title: Unit-compatible Koszul-to-quotient comparison in the completed coefficient presentation
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme and $d$ a Noetherian adic coefficient datum over a commutative ring $A$ as in [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], with ideal $I$. Let $a:\operatorname{Fin}(r)\to A$ generate $I$. For any $K$ in the derived category of modules over the actual completed coefficient ring $A_T$, and any cochain representative $C$ with an isomorphism $e:Q(C)\simeq K$, there is an isomorphism from the transported intrinsic Koszul completion of [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion] to $\operatorname{Rlim}(K\otimes^L_{A_T}(A/I^{n+1})_T)_n$, using the strict reduction tower of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum] and the actual total right derived limit of [prop-weil-pbc-rlim-functoriality]. Composing the specified intrinsic completion unit with this isomorphism gives the derived constant/limit adjunction unit followed by the derived limit of the residue-normalized strict quotient augmentation. No completeness hypothesis is imposed on $K$. The coefficient universe is one above the scheme universe, as in the recorded reductionModules presentation.

source.place: current order 1316, Koszul-to-quotient comparison, including its unit equation

proof.text: Use the joint coefficient transport to compare both the intrinsic Koszul fiber and the actual quotient completion to constant quotient completion under one faithful derived equivalence.

Transport the Koszul comparison along the supplied representative isomorphism Q(C) to K, then compose with the inverse quotient comparison. Full faithfulness lifts this composite to the actual completed-coefficient derived category. Naturality of the constant completion unit and the two supplied unit equations identify the lifted unit composite with the specified actual quotient-completion unit.

lean.statement:
theorem completedKoszulQuotientComparison
    (T : Scheme.{t}) {A : Type (t + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (r : ℕ) (a : Fin r → A) (ha : Ideal.span (Set.range a) = d.ideal)
    (K : d.derived T)
    (C : CochainComplex (reductionModules T (d.completedRing T)) ℤ)
    (eC : DerivedCategory.Q.obj C ≅ K) :
    ∃ c : intrinsicCompletion T d r a ha K C eC ≅
        (completedRlim T (d.completedRing T)).obj ((completedReductionTower T d).obj K),
      intrinsicCompletionUnit T d r a ha K C eC ≫ c.hom =
        ((constLimAdj :
          (Functor.const ℕᵒᵖ : reductionModules T (d.completedRing T) ⥤ d.towers T) ⊣
            completedTowerLimit T (d.completedRing T)).mapDerivedCategoryRightDerivedAdjunction
              ).unit.app K ≫
          (completedRlim T (d.completedRing T)).map ((completedReductionTowerUnit d T).app K)
